title: Sovereignty on Loan: Infrastructure, Financing and Fiscal Governance of Data Centres in Dakar, Senegal
why_not: States a 30,000-litre diesel reserve at Diamniadio and that no Dakar operator publishes a PUE; no secured supply, set-aside power, PUE of 1.6 or less or water figure, and no data centre stopped for want of power.
